groups.directions:
Topic: Fill in the Blanks
Subtopic: Single Blank

questions.text: The sudden resignation of the CEO left the company in a state of complete ________.
questions.explanation: The sudden resignation of a top leader typically causes chaos or confusion. "Turmoil" means a state of great disturbance or uncertainty, which fits perfectly.

questions.text: Despite the heavy rain, the football match proceeded as ________.
questions.explanation: The word "Despite" introduces a contrast. Even though it was raining heavily, the match happened anyway. "Scheduled" correctly completes the phrase "proceeded as scheduled".

questions.text: The teacher asked the students to ________ from talking during the final examination.
questions.explanation: The context is an examination where talking is not allowed. "Refrain" means to stop oneself from doing something, and it correctly takes the preposition "from".

questions.text: Her exceptional performance in the interview ________ her a lucrative job offer.
questions.explanation: An exceptional performance would lead to gaining a job offer. "Secured" means succeeded in obtaining or achieving something.

questions.text: The government has launched a new initiative to ________ poverty in rural areas.
questions.explanation: Poverty is a negative condition that a government would want to remove or destroy. "Eradicate" means to destroy completely or put an end to.

groups.directions:
Topic: Fill in the Blanks
Subtopic: Single Blank

questions.text: The author's latest novel is highly ________, drawing heavily from esoteric philosophical concepts.
questions.explanation: The sentence mentions the novel draws from "esoteric" (obscure, hard to understand) concepts. "Opaque" in this context means hard to understand or not transparent, aligning with "esoteric".

questions.text: In an effort to ________ the growing public outrage, the mayor issued a public apology.
questions.explanation: The mayor issued an apology to calm or reduce the public outrage. "Mollify" means to appease the anger or anxiety of someone.

questions.text: The scientist's findings were met with skepticism, as they seemed to ________ established physical laws.
questions.explanation: Findings are met with skepticism if they go against what is already known. "Contradict" means to be in conflict with.

questions.text: Her argument was so ________ that even her fiercest opponents were forced to agree with her.
questions.explanation: An argument that forces opponents to agree must be very strong and convincing. "Compelling" means evoking interest, attention, or admiration in a powerfully irresistible way.

questions.text: The company’s financial records were intentionally ________ to hide the massive embezzlement.
questions.explanation: To hide embezzlement, records must be made unclear or confusing. "Obfuscated" means rendered obscure, unclear, or unintelligible.

groups.directions:
Topic: Fill in the Blanks
Subtopic: Single Blank

questions.text: The diplomat’s ________ remarks during the press conference nearly triggered an international crisis.
questions.explanation: Remarks that trigger an international crisis must be highly provocative. "Incendiary" means designed to cause fires, or in this context, tending to stir up conflict.

questions.text: Despite his ________ demeanor in public, he was known to be quite ruthless in the boardroom.
questions.explanation: The word "Despite" indicates a contrast with "ruthless". We need a word meaning friendly or good-natured. "Affable" means friendly, good-natured, or easy to talk to.

questions.text: The committee rejected the proposal, stating that the project was fundamentally ________ and bound to fail.
questions.explanation: If the project is "bound to fail," it must have serious errors. "Flawed" means having a blemish or imperfection; fundamentally incorrect.

questions.text: The ancient civilization was characterized by a deeply ________ society, where social mobility was virtually impossible.
questions.explanation: A society where social mobility is impossible is divided into rigid classes. "Stratified" means arranged in layers or classes.
